This experience requirement may be fulfilled by: (i) working 5 years in a major phase of the plumbing business, verified by time or pay records; or (ii) completing an apprenticeship program meeting the standards set by the department or the United States department of labor, bureau of apprenticeship.

exams.name: Journeyman Plumber Written Examination
exams.notes: Board prescribes the examination; may also require a practical demonstration.
exams.quote: satisfactory completion of a written examination prescribed by the board and conducted by the department, subject to 37-1-101 (4), testing the applicant's knowledge of techniques and methods employed in the field of plumbing and, if required by the board, a practical demonstration establishing competence in the special skills required in the field of plumbing.

exams.name: Master Plumber Examination
exams.notes: Board prescribes; tests knowledge, skill, and ability in the field of plumbing.
exams.quote: satisfactory completion of an examination prescribed by the board for master plumbers testing the applicant's knowledge of the field of plumbing and demonstrating skill and ability in the field of plumbing.

available.quote: A person with a valid medical gas piping installation endorsement from another state may install medical gas piping in this state.

requirements.value: Out-of-state medical gas piping installation endorsement holders may install medical gas piping in Montana; broader reciprocity for plumber licenses not explicitly addressed in the statute.
requirements.quote: A person with a valid medical gas piping installation endorsement from another state may install medical gas piping in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material deceit in procuring, attempting to procure, or aiding and abetting procurement of a license or endorsement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: material deceit in procuring, attempting to procure, or aiding and abetting the procurement of an occupational license or endorsement to practice in the field of plumbing;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfitness to provide plumbing services by reason of negligence or addiction to habit-forming drugs.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: unfitness to provide services in the field of plumbing by reason of negligence or addiction to the use of habit-forming drugs;
